types.name: data
types.description:
The data passed to the auth provider when authenticating a user
or validating a callback.

children.name: url
children.description: URL of the incoming authentication request.

children.name: headers
children.description: Headers of incoming authentication request.

children.name: query
children.description: Query params of the incoming authentication request.

children.name: body
children.description:
Body of the incoming authentication request.

One of the arguments that is suggested to be treated in a standard manner is a `callback_url` field.
The field specifies where the user is redirected to after a successful authentication in the case of Oauth auhentication.
If not passed, the provider will fallback to the callback\_url provided in the provider options.

children.name: protocol
children.description: Protocol of the incoming authentication request (For example, `https`).

children.name: create
children.type: (`data`: ``{ entity_id: string ; provider_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> ; user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>  }``) => Promise<[AuthIdentityDTO](/references/auth/interfaces/auth.AuthIdentityDTO)>

children.name: update
children.type: (`entity_id`: `string`, `data`: ``{ provider_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> ; user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown>  }``) => Promise<[AuthIdentityDTO](/references/auth/interfaces/auth.AuthIdentityDTO)>

children.name: success
children.description: Whether the authentication was successful.

children.name: authIdentity
children.description: The authenticated user's details.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the auth identity.

children.name: provider_identities
children.description: The list of provider identities linked to the auth identity.

children.name: app_metadata
children.description: Holds information related to the actor IDs tied to the auth identity.

children.name: mfaChallenge
children.description: The multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge to complete before issuing a token.

children.name: id
children.description: The multi-factor authentication (MFA) challenge's ID.

children.name: auth_identity_id
children.description: The ID of the authentication identity being challenged.

children.name: auth_identity
children.description: The authentication identity being challenged.

children.name: auth_provider
children.description: The authentication provider handling the challenge.

children.name: methods
children.description: Available methods for completing this challenge.

children.name: expires_at
children.description: When the challenge expires.

children.name: attempts
children.description: Number of verification attempts made.

children.name: max_attempts
children.description: Maximum verification attempts allowed.

children.name: completed_at
children.description: When the challenge was completed.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Additional metadata for the challenge.

children.name: error
children.description:
If an error occurs during the authentication process,
whether within the Auth Module or a third-party provider,
the error message is set in this field.

children.name: location
children.description:
The URL to redirect to for further authentication action
with a third-party provider. This takes precedence before
the `success` field.

So, after checking that authentication is successful,
you should check whether this field is defined and, if so, redirect to the
specified location.
